checks.detail: Exact zero-based integer 0..total-1 requests one 500-row page at clamp(target-250,0,total-500); no client scan or full payload.
Clearing alone only clears value/validation; explicit empty Enter/action resets page 1; typed inline status owns invalid/loading/success/error.
Jump increments the stable window token, replaces rows, focuses and scrolls target to center without selection/highlight; v39 sliding resumes.
Only successful calculated TIME record for exact record.displayId/paneId contributes rows matching signal_name through existing signalNameMatches and containing sample_index.
Point number remains first/left; existing extrema marker follows with row.signal_color; lowest finite graph_number wins, response order breaks ties.
Spectrum extrema bins are never projected onto raw TIME sample indices.
Sample table uses auto layout; first column prefers 1% with exact 112px minimum; other column declarations and row styles are unchanged.
No production, backend, test, Git or runtime file changed; two additive fragments integrate into existing app.css/app.js.
